Former South Korean First Lady Kim Keon Hee Jailed for Bribery

Former South Korean First Lady Kim Keon Hee has been sentenced to seven years in jail. The conviction stems from a case involving allegations of accepting valuable gifts, including luxury items, in exchange for political favors and personnel appointments. This sentencing adds to a previous sentence she is reportedly serving.
